data.title: Signature Livings
data.about:
It gives me great pleasure to introduce to you a very unique, once-in-a-lifetime project. Presenting Dubai’s first solar-powered, eco-home, Signature Livings. Crafted by Green Group, this project is an eco-friendly development with reduced carbon footprint. Offering studios, 1 & 2 bedroom apartments, they have a special offer for studios with guaranteed rental income with lower service charge. 

As we move into the future, we have to make it a sustainable one for our future generations. Signature Livings takes this green living to the next level. The only solar-powered eco-home in Dubai, these homes offer the perfect amalgamation of luxury and sustainable lifestyle.

location_tile.title: The eco-friendly homes at Signature Livings are located within Nakheel’s Jumeirah Village Circle in Dubai.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Jumeirah Village is the heart of Dubai. Located on Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road between Hessa Street and Al Khail Road, Jumeirah Village as it is more commonly referred to, is a family oriented community consisting of villas and apartments.
